title: Alleged Operator of Webtoon Piracy Website Newtoki Extradited From Japan to S. Korea
content:
The suspected operator behind Newtoki, one of South Korea's largest illegal webtoon distribution sites, was extradited from Japan to Korea, marking a major breakthrough in its efforts to combat global digital piracy.

The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) announced the 37-year-old suspect was repatriated from Japan on Thursday via Gimpo International Airport under the Korea-Japan extradition treaty. The individual, a former Korean national who reportedly acquired Japanese citizenship in 2022, is accused of running a large-scale piracy network for years.

Authorities allege the operator distributed thousands of unauthorized works — including popular manga titles like Slam Dunk and One Piece — and generated illicit profits through advertising. The case is particularly significant as it marks the first time Japan has extradited one of its own nationals to South Korea under the bilateral agreement.

Officials emphasized the extradition demonstrates stronger international cooperation in addressing overseas copyright crimes that impact Korea's webtoon and broader content industry. Investigations will now focus on uncovering the full scope of the operation, including its structure and financial gains, with plans to track and recover illegal proceeds.

The development follows the recent shutdown of Newtoki and its affiliated platforms, including Manatoki (for Japanese manga) and Booktoki (for web novels). The sites ceased operations in late April amid increasing regulatory pressure. The timing of the closure — shortly before the implementation of South Korea's emergency site-blocking system on May 11 — had already signaled mounting enforcement efforts.

South Korea's Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism Hwi-young Chae addressed the issue of the operator of Newtoki earlier this month, stating "We will pursue this to the end." Newtoki has long been considered one of the largest illegal webtoon distribution platforms, and industry creators had called on the Japanese government to cooperate in extraditing the operator.

With the operator now in custody, authorities say the case represents a turning point in holding major overseas piracy actors accountable.

title: 'Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Fall 2026 Debut
content:
WWWaveCorporation 's Deregula animation label opened an official website for the television anime adaptation of Shaoh 's Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru ( I'm Dating a Dark Summoner ) web manga on Friday, revealing the main cast, production staff, and a key visual (pictured). The anime series is scheduled to premiere in October 2026.

Cast Amona: Rei Takano Roni: Yuuki Nishiyama Imp: Houdentei Senmai

Staff Director, Series Composition, Script: Seiya Miyajima ( Umayon ) Character Design, Chief Animation Director: Takahiro Sasaki ( Kitaku-bu Katsudou Kiroku ) Sound Director: Fumihiko Ootera ( Class no Daikirai na Joshi to Kekkon suru Koto ni Natta. ) Art Director: Yamamoto Youichirou ( Lapis Re:LiGHTs ) Color Design: Daiki Ura ( Sawaranaide Kotesashi-kun ) Director of Photography: Yuu Oozu ( Guraburu! ) Editing: Sen Hayashima ( Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Game: The Chronicles ) Producer: Aoki Yasuhiro ( BanG Dream! Garupa☆Pico: Oomori ), Kota Hashiguchi ( Hana wa Saku, Shura no Gotoku assistant production manager) Studio: AtoriE Co-Studio: Nyan Pollution-ω-

Shoah began serializing the fantasy comedy web manga in Dra-Dra Sharp# website in November 2021. Kadokawa published the seventh volume on March 9.

title: Akira Animation Director & Chainsaw Man S1 Producer Unite for Upcoming OROCHI Anime Pilot
content:
The program for Annecy’s MIFA (International Animation Film Festival and Market) pitches includes the pilot film OROCHI -Seventh Echoes- , directed by Takashi Nakamura ( Akira animation direction and more) and produced by Makoto Kimura, who has produced various anime, including the first season of Chainsaw Man at MAPPA.

OROCHI -Seventh Echoes- is labeled an adventure fantasy film for children to adults, and adapts an original story credited to BLUE RIGHTS, the company Kimura founded after leaving MAPPA. This is a pilot, but the final film’s runtime is listed as 1.5 hours, with animation hand-drawn on paper. A teaser image from the film and its synopsis are below.

ALSO READ: Production I.G Chairman Warns of Anime Bubble and Japan’s ‘Elimination’ If It Doesn’t Develop Producers on a Global Level

After Leaving MAPPA, Chainsaw Man & Jujutsu Kaisen Producer Takes on Upcoming OROCHI Pilot Film

OROCHI -Seventh Echoes- is described: Born with the forbidden power known as Hizumi, Prince Agni is abandoned at birth. When Orochi, a spirit of vengeance born from a thousand-year-old betrayal, awakens, the world faces destruction. Agni must confront his destiny to break the cycle of hatred.

The film joins several other anime pilots in the Global Anime Challenge (GAC) panel at MIFA. GAC is a project supporting creators in developing their own IP and gaining a global perspective. Supporting this effort include studio Kinema Citrus, Japan’s Agency of Cultural Affairs’ Creator’s Support Fund, the Japan Arts Council, and the Japan Research Institute, with mentorship from various veteran producers and participation from notable anime studios . The pilot screenings allow these creatives to secure funding, collaboration, and coproduction.

You can check out the other works that’ll be screened at MIFA’s Global Anime Challenge: Original IP Projects Part 1 and Part 2 at their respective links.

Meet Japan’s top emerging creators selected for the Global Anime Challenge, a national initiative shaping the next generation of anime talent. Eleven participants take the stage with projects developed through the Global Anime Challenge. Since selection in 2024, they have refined their original IPs and completed international internships in early 2026 — this is their culmination. Presenting in English, they seek collaboration, partnerships and co-production. Global Anime Challenge is a three-year program supported by the Japan Creator Support Fund, nurturing the next generation of anime directors, producers and animators.

title: 'Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs, First Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Otsuji 's Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi ( My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked ) manga revealed three additional cast members, the theme songs, and first promotional video on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on July 8 at 11:30 p.m. on Television Kanagawa, TeleTama, and Chiba TV, followed by MBS, Tokyo MX, and BS Asahi.

Cast Yaeko Kouzou: Miyari Nemoto ( Ruri no Houseki ) Nago: Yumi Uchiyama ( Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei ) Mitsuya: M・A・O ( Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken )

Singer-songwriter Lia ( Angel Beats! ) is performing the opening theme "Amayadori no Shoukei." Idol group AVAM ( Akujiki Reijou to Kyouketsu Koushaku ) is performing the ending theme "Claire." Both theme songs are previewed in the promotional video below.

Keisuke Inoue ( Otome Game no Hametsu Flag shika Nai Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei shiteshimatta... ) is directing the anime at NEWON , with Nanami Hoshino ( Saikin Yatotta Maid ga Ayashii script) handling the series composition. Mutsumi Sasaki ( Yuru Camp△ ) is designing the characters. Rina Tayama ( Silent Witch ) is composing the music.

Otsuji began drawing the historical slice of life manga on their X (formerly Twitter) account in September 2020 before beginning regular serialization on the Comic POOL web magazine in November 2020. Ichijinsha published the ninth volume on February 26.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English in October 2022. The eighth volume shipped on June 23.

PV 1

title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Anime Casts Sumo Wrestlers Tamawashi, Tamashoho
content:
CyberAgent revealed on Friday that Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia , the television anime of Tomato Soup 's A Witch's Life in Mongol ( Tenmaku no Jādūgar ) manga, has cast Mongolian wrestlers Tamawashi and Tamashoho (full names Ichiro Tamawashi and Manpei Tamashoho) in the series. Both are active professional sumo wrestlers and are from the Kataonami stable. Tamawashi will voice Genghis Khan, the founder of the Mongol Empire. Tamashoho will play a resilient Mongol soldier. Both will also voice other characters in the series.

CyberAgent also released an English-subtitled video featuring the two wrestlers discussing their anime voice acting debut.

The anime will have its world premiere screening of the first 3 episodes on June 13 at United Cinemas Aqua City Odaiba.

The anime will screen in competition at this year's Annecy International Animation Film Festival in France in the TV Films category. Anime Expo will also host the U.S. premiere screening of the anime on July 3. The anime's chief director Naoko Yamada and director Abel Góngora will be in attendance at the screening.

The anime stars:

• Miyu Irino as Shira

• Jun Saitō as Muhammad

• Akira Sekine as Shitara (also written as Sitara)

• Houko Kuwashima as Fatima

• Ryōta Suzuki as Tolui

• Kenji Nojima as Jochi

• Ami Koshimizu as Töregene

• Hiro Shimono as Ögedei

• Daisuke Namikawa as Chagatai

Naoko Yamada ( The Heike Story , A Silent Voice , The Colors Within ) is serving as chief director, and Abel Góngora ( DAN DA DAN season 2, Scott Pilgrim Takes Off , Star Wars: Visions ' "TO-B1") is directing the anime at Science SARU . Kenichi Yoshida ( Eureka Seven , Gundam: Reconguista in G ) is designing the characters and serving as animation chief, and Kanichi Katō ( Black Clover , The Eminence in Shadow ) is overseeing the series scripts. Kōshirō Hino is composing the music.

Additional staff includes:

• Technical Director Chief: Takuya Fujikura

• Art Director: Yuri Kabasawa

• Color Key Artist: Narumi Konno

• Compositing Director of Photography: Naoki Takahashi

• Editing: Kiyoshi Hirose

• Sound Director: Noriyoshi Konuma

SEKAI NO OWARI performs the opening theme song "Stella."

Yen Press is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

The time: the thirteenth century. The place: Yeke Mongol Ulus, the greatest empire the world has ever known. The woman: Fatima, hailing from Persia, where medical technique and scientific knowledge have been perfected beyond all precedent. Fatima's desire for a stage where she can put her knowledge to work has brought her to the palace of the Mongols, where she falls under the wing of Töregene, the sixth wife of Ögedei, the second Great Khan—a mighty woman with complicated feelings about the direction of the empire. These two women are the axel upon which the politics of the palace, and soon the very world, will turn…

Tomato Soup launched the manga on Akita Shoten 's Souffle website in September 2021. Akita Shoten will publish the manga's sixth compiled book volume on July 15.

The series began publishing simultaneously in Akita Shoten 's Mystery Bonita in March 2025, on top of its publication on the Souffle website. The manga was being published bimonthly until last summer, where it then went on hiatus for Tomato Soup 's maternity leave. The manga returned on March 25.

The manga topped the Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2023 rankings for female readers, and ranked #11 in the 2024 rankings for female readers. The manga was nominated for the 16th Manga Taisho Awards in 2023, and was nominated once again for the Manga Taisho Awards the following year in 2024. The manga was nominated for the Best New Manga category in the second American Manga Awards. The manga recently won the grand prize in the Comic division of the 55th Japan Cartoonists Association Awards.

title: 'Kekkaishi no Ichirinka' Reveals Main Cast, Additional Staff, Teaser Promo for Winter 2027
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kureha 's Kekkaishi no Ichirinka ( Bride of the Barrier Master ) novel revealed the main cast, additional staff, a second teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video on Friday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027.

Voice actors Akari Kitou ( Ao no Hako ) and Kikunosuke Toya ( Chainsaw Man ) are starring as Hana Ichise and Saku Ichinomiya, respectively.

Yukari Hashimoto ( Komi-san wa, Comyushou desu. ), Ruka Kawada ( Toumei Otoko to Ningen Onna ), and R・O・N ( Tensei shitara Dainana Ouji Datta node, Kimama ni Majutsu wo Kiwamemasu ) are serving as the music composers.

Tooru Kitahata ( Nihon e Youkoso Elf-san. ) is directing the anime at TROYCA , with Yuuko Kakihara ( Giji Harem ) handling the series composition and script. Minami Murayama ( Atri: My Dear Moments prop design) is designing the characters.

Kureha published the romantic supernatural novel under its Kadokawa Bunko imprint in December 2021, featuring illustrations by Bodax . The sixth volume was released in August 2025, with the seventh volume going on sale on June 16.

Odayaka began drawing a manga adaptation in B's-LOG Comic magazine in May 2020. Kadokawa published the seventh volume in December 2025, with the eighth volume scheduled for a July 30 release.

J-Novel Club licensed both the light novel and manga in English release in August 2022 and July 2023, respectively. The fourth light novel volume shipped on July 15. The sixth manga volume went on sale on May 26.

title: Kagurabachi Anime Reveals Chihiro Rokuhira Character Visual and Trailer
content:
The upcoming KAGURABACHI anime adaptation revealed a new character visual and trailer for the protagonist, Chihiro Rokuhira. The highly anticipated anime is set to premiere in April 2027, while it will have its world premiere next month during Anime Expo 2026.

Studio Cypic will handle the animation production, with Tetsuya Takeuchi as the director. Takeuchi is famously known for the Rock Lee vs Gaara fight in Naruto. We previously also had the chance to interview CyberAgent’s Takahiro Yamauchi , who talked about the company and its goal of creating “ high-quality Japanese animation works that can be accepted globally .”

Taihi Kimura voices Chihiro, and you can watch the new character trailer below.

The main staff for the anime includes:

• Director: Tetsuya Takeuchi

• Character Design: Keigo Sasaki

• Production: Cypic

The story follows the young Chihiro, who was trained by his father to become a swordsmith. After his father is murderer, Chihiro sets on a path of revenge to avenge him with yakuza and sorcerers standing against him. The official synopsis:

Flames of resolve, kindled by hatred. Chihiro Rokuhira is a boy who aspires to become a swordsmith, and took daily training under his father Kunishige, a renowned swordsmith. Their days, once filled with laughter, are brutally torn apart by an attack from the mysterious sorcerer organization, the Hishaku. What is stolen from them are the six Enchanted Blades—swords of immense power capable of shaping the fate of the nation—and the gentle, warm life they once shared. From that day on, everything changed. In a world engulfed in darkness, Chihiro takes up Enten, the seventh Enchanted Blade left behind by his father, and sets out on a blood-soaked path of revenge.

The first teaser trailer for the anime exceeded 6 million views within the first 24 hours, and you can check it out below.

title: Bride of the Barrier Master Reveals Visual, Trailer, Main Cast, January 2027 Premiere
content:
The previously announced Bride of the Barrier Master anime revealed a new visual, first trailer, main cast, and a January 2027 premiere. TROYCA is animating the series.

The series stars:

• Akari Kito as Hana Ichise

• Kikunosuke Toya as Saku Ichinomiya

Toru Kitahata is the director, while Yuko Kakihara is in charge of the series composition, and Minami Murayama is handling the character designs.

The anime is based on a novel series written by Kureha with illustrations by Bodax. It was launched in December 2021 under Kadokawa Bunko. Odayaka is illustrating the manga adaptation, which began serialization in B’s Log Comic (Enterbrain) in March 2022. Yen Press licensed both the novel and manga in English, describing the story:

For thousands of years, Japan has been protected by five clans wielding barrier-weaving magic. Born to a branch family of one such clan, eighteen-year-old Hana has always been stuck in the shadow of her more capable, beautiful, and popular twin sister. When a strong power awakens within Hana, she chooses to hide it so she can continue living a quiet life out of the spotlight. Toru Kitahata is the director, while Yuko Kakihara is in charge of the series composition, and Minami Murayama is handling the character designs.

title: Kanojo No Tomodachi Anime Premieres in October
content:
The production team behind Kanojo no Tomodachi ( My Girlfriend’s Friend ) has announced an October premiere for the erotic drama anime. Alongside that announcement, a visual and cast/staff members were announced.

Studio Quad, the company behind My Life as Inukai-san’s Dog , will animate the adaptation. Andou Takashi will direct the anime. Akira Koshiishi, Masayuki Fujita, and Ryuuji Iwata will be the anime’s chief animation directors. Additional production staff includes

• Gokou Shiraki —Script, Series Composition

• Hiroki Nishiyama — Sound Director

• Junichi Masunaga — Editing

• Makoto Tougou —Director of Photography

• Naoto Tanno — Producer

The anime’s VA cast includes Ryuuga Nagaike as Takeru Hidaka, Sayaka Hashi as Kaori Koga, and Miki Hase as Tomoko Yoshioka.

WWWave Corp.’s Deregula is producing the anime. Different versions of the anime (broadcast and uncensored) are expected.

Kanojo no Tomodachi Details & Synopsis

Jura wrote and illustrated the Kanojo no Tomodachi manga. Kodansha’s YanMaga Web has serialized the manga since its May 2021 debut. Comic Days and Magazine Pocket also serialized My Friend’s Girlfriend. The series currently has eight chapters.

Kanojo no Tomodachi focuses on the romantic life of Takeru Hidaka, a student who aspires to be a doctor and has recently been accepted into medical school.

On the surface, Takeru’s life seems enviable; he’s proficient at his studies, well-liked, and loved by his girlfriend Kaori Koga. But underneath it, Takeru has always been overtly affectionate of Kaori’s friend, Tomoko Yoshioka. Yet, once Kaori asked him out, his love for Tomoko never came to fruition. But to Takeru’s surprise, Tomoko is not only interested in him, but she also begins to seduce him every chance she gets. Initially, he declines her advances. But how long can he continue to turn away a girl that he finds maddeningly appealing?
